news.headline: Intel’s $28B Ohio Chip Project Hits Construction Milestone After Years Of Delays — Arizona Fab Targets 2028 Start
news.summary: Intel's Ohio factory, originally expected to begin production in 2025, is now targeting operations in 2030–2031 as the chipmaker looks to expand U.S. manufacturing capacity.

news.headline: Intel advances Arizona, Ohio factory projects as chip demand outlook improves
news.summary: Investing.com -- Intel is making progress on its long-delayed U.S. factory expansion, with equipment installation underway at a new Arizona plant and construction advancing at its planned Ohio complex, Bloomberg first reported.

news.headline: Anthropic Has Locked In Over $600 Billion of Computing, More Than Intel Is Worth. It Still Wants More and That’s Big News for AMD.
news.summary: Anthropic just committed a staggering sum to computing power before its IPO, and its appetite keeps growing even as losses mount. One chipmaker stands out as the biggest beneficiary, and its stock is already moving.

news.headline: Elon Musk May Have Ended the October AI Crash as NVIDIA, Intel, and SanDisk Rally after One SpaceX Quote
news.summary: One quote from Elon Musk sent chip stocks surging in premarket trading, but whether that momentum signals a real turning point or just a brief relief rally is what the rest of October will decide.
